findings: Billaudot identifies Méditation, op. 37, in B-flat saxophone/clarinet with piano, AF0021-A, and separately E-flat saxophone with piano, AF0021-C.
The UMP saxophone catalog explicitly offers soprano, alto, or tenor saxophone with piano.
Conservatorio di Udine's annual saxophone-family course includes Méditation op. 37 under soprano saxophone and piano. This is direct conservatory repertoire context.
So French by Alexandre Doisy contains Sporck's Légende and Massenet's Méditation de Thaïs; it is not an exact recording of Sporck's Méditation.

evidence.claim: Op.37 B-flat saxophone or clarinet and piano, AF0021-A
E-flat saxophone and piano edition AF0021-C
Conservatory soprano saxophone and piano course repertoire

arranger-edition: Méditation, op. 37; B-flat edition also for clarinet; E-flat edition also available

gaps: Original composition date, duration, arranger credit, and exact recording unresolved.
